about: Every interface the h2t-ops pack and POS share. POS pins a version and validates against it. A breaking change to a stable entry needs a new major version (#582).

interfaces.name: H2T_PATH_VAULT
interfaces.meaning: The vault root both sides read. Unset: ~/.dor/vault. Resolved by the pack, never spelled by POS.

interfaces.name: h2t-ops paths get
interfaces.meaning: One path per place, so POS asks instead of spelling it. secret:* ids are outside this contract until #584.

interfaces.name: lake
interfaces.meaning: Each connector writes only its own files under lake/<provider>/ and lists them in manifest.jsonl. POS reads; POS does not write there.

interfaces.name: connector cursors
interfaces.meaning: Sync position of granola and meetgeek. Pack-private: POS neither reads nor writes it, and asks the connector for messages since a cursor instead.

interfaces.name: google token mirror
interfaces.meaning: One-way 3.x-shaped copy of the Google token, written only if the file already exists. The access token in it expires within an hour; #584 replaces it.
